# Haggai Chapter 1 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HAG_001_page_001.jpg

---

**1:1** In-the-second [bi-shenat shtayim] year of-Daryavesh [Darius] the-king, in-the-sixth [ba-shishi] month [ba-chodesh], on-the-first [be-yom echad] day of-the-month, the-word of-YHWH came [hayah] by-the-hand [be-yad] of-Chaggai [Haggai] the-prophet [ha-navi] to Zerubbavel [Zerubbabel] son of-She'altiel [Shealtiel], governor [pachat] of-Yehudah, and-to Yehoshua [Joshua] son of-Yehotsadaq [Jehozadak], the-great [ha-gadol] priest [ha-kohen], saying:

**1:4** "Is-it a-time [et] for-you yourselves [lakhem attem] to-dwell [lashevet] in-your-paneled [sefunim] houses [batteikhem], while-this house [ha-bayit ha-zeh] [lies] in-ruins [charev]?"

**1:6** "You-have-sown [zera'tem] much [harbeh] and-brought-in [have] little [me'at]; you-eat [akhol] but-have-not enough [ve-ein le-sovah]; you-drink [shato] but-are-not filled [ve-ein le-shokrah]; you-clothe-yourselves [lavosh] but-no-one [ve-ein] is-warm [le-cham]; and-whoever-earns-wages [veha-mistakker] earns-them into-a-bag [tseror] with-holes [naquv]."
